ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis Shooting
ideas.description: An investigation into the circumstances surrounding the shooting of a man by federal agents in Minneapolis
ideas.angle: Police brutality and use of force
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Was the use of force justified?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover systemic issues with police brutality and the use of force by federal agents.

ideas.title: Impact of Public Health Funding Freeze
ideas.description: An investigation into the impact of the Trump administration's freeze and reversal of public health funding to cities and states
questions: What are the potential consequences of the funding freeze on public health programs and services?
How will this impact vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover the significant impacts of the funding freeze on public health programs and services.
